notice: Illustrative demonstration ruleset for an independent prototype. It is NOT an official AICTE checklist. Rules marked state_circular_derived are modelled on one state directorate circular and have not been confirmed against the AICTE Approval Process Handbook.

rules.name: Occupancy certificate is required
rules.description: An occupancy certificate must be uploaded.
rules.source_ref: https://dtekerala.gov.in/static/DEPTCIRCULARS/240112AICTE.pdf (Kerala DTE circular, 12.01.2024, item 2); also listed as a commonly required document in AICTE letter AICTE/Adv/AB/APH/2022-23 dated 06.12.2021 (indicative list, not the current handbook)
rules.remediation: Upload a copy of the occupancy certificate.

rules.name: Latest approval letter is required
rules.description: The latest approval letter must be uploaded for extension of approval.
rules.remediation: Upload the latest approval letter.

rules.name: University affiliation letter is required
rules.description: A university affiliation letter must be uploaded for extension of approval.
rules.remediation: Upload the current university affiliation letter.

rules.name: Government approval is required
rules.description: A government approval / NOC document must be uploaded.
rules.remediation: Upload the government approval or no-objection document.

rules.name: Application details are complete
rules.description: Institution name, identifier, state, address and at least one course are required.
rules.remediation: Complete the missing application details.

rules.name: Institution identifier has the expected shape
rules.description: Identifiers seen on public sample approval letters look like 1-<8 to 12 digits>.
rules.source_ref: Pattern inferred from publicly visible institution letters; unconfirmed
rules.remediation: Check the identifier against your approval letter.

rules.name: Institution name must appear on every document
rules.description: Each supporting document should show the institution name.
rules.remediation: Upload a document that clearly shows the institution name.

rules.name: Institution identifier must appear on approval and affiliation letters
rules.description: Approval and affiliation letters should show the institution identifier.
rules.remediation: Upload a legible copy that shows the identifier.

rules.name: Certificate number must appear
rules.description: Certificates and government letters should show a reference number.
rules.remediation: Upload a copy that shows the certificate or letter number.

rules.name: Issue date must appear
rules.description: Every document should show its date of issue.
rules.remediation: Upload a copy that shows the issue date.

rules.name: Validity date must appear on affiliation and government letters
rules.description: Year-wise approvals should show how long they are valid.
rules.remediation: Upload a copy that shows the validity date.

rules.name: Course and intake must appear on approval and affiliation letters
rules.description: Each listed course should carry an approved intake.
rules.remediation: Upload a copy that lists the intake for each course.

rules.name: Dates must be valid calendar dates
rules.description: Every extracted date must be readable and exist on the calendar (day-first format).
rules.remediation: Check the date on the document; if it is correct, ask the reviewer to confirm.

rules.name: Documents must not be expired
rules.description: A validity date earlier than today means the document has lapsed.
rules.remediation: Upload the renewed document.

rules.name: Issue date must not be after the validity date
rules.description: Contradictory dates on one document.
rules.remediation: Check both dates against the original document.

rules.name: Issue date must not be in the future
rules.description: A document cannot have been issued after today.
rules.remediation: Check the issue date against the original document.

rules.name: Intake values must be positive whole numbers
rules.description: Applicant-entered and document intake values must be valid numbers.
rules.remediation: Correct the intake value.

rules.name: Institution name matches the application
rules.description: The name on each document is compared with the application.
rules.remediation: Confirm the institution name, or upload the correct document.

rules.name: Institution identifier matches the application
rules.description: The identifier on each document is compared with the application.
rules.remediation: Confirm the identifier, or upload the correct document.

rules.name: Document refers to this application
rules.description: An application reference printed on a document must match this application.
rules.remediation: Upload a document issued for this application.

rules.name: Course names match the application
rules.description: Each course on a document should correspond to an application course.
rules.remediation: Check the course name on the document and in the application.

rules.name: Intake matches the application
rules.description: Intake on a document is compared with the intake entered in the application.
rules.remediation: Confirm the intake; correct the application or upload the right document.

rules.name: Certificate numbers agree across documents of one type
rules.description: Two documents of the same type should not show different certificate numbers.
rules.remediation: Confirm which certificate applies and remove the other.

rules.name: Same file uploaded more than once
rules.description: Byte-identical files (same SHA-256) inside one application.
rules.remediation: Remove the duplicate upload.

rules.name: Same file used by a different institution's application
rules.description: A byte-identical file appears in an application for a different institution.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should confirm the document belongs to this institution.

rules.name: Certificate number already used by a different institution
rules.description: The same certificate number appears in another institution's application.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should confirm which institution the certificate was issued to.

rules.name: Near-identical document content
rules.description: Very similar text or image to a different file. Shared issuer templates can raise similarity legitimately.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should compare the two documents side by side.

rules.name: File metadata anomaly
rules.description: Unusual PDF metadata. Informational prompt for a human, never proof of tampering.
rules.remediation: Reviewer may compare against the original source if concerned.

rules.name: PDF contains scripts or embedded files
rules.description: Active or embedded content is never executed here, but is flagged.
rules.remediation: Ask the applicant for a flattened copy of the document.

rules.name: Official source verification
rules.description: Result of a trusted-source verification attempt. Simulated results are labelled and never count as verified.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should verify the document through an approved channel.

rules.name: Upload rejected
rules.description: The file could not be accepted (type, size, corruption).
rules.remediation: Upload a valid, unprotected PDF, PNG or JPEG.

rules.name: Text could not be read
rules.description: No usable text could be extracted, so no field checks were possible.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should inspect the original; the applicant can upload a clearer scan.

rules.name: Low OCR confidence
rules.description: Text was read, but with low confidence; extracted values may be wrong.
rules.remediation: Reviewer should check the extracted values against the original.

rules.name: Declared type differs from detected type
rules.description: The document text suggests a different type from the one selected.
rules.remediation: Confirm the document category.
